scenarios.scenario: Surface — Identify build error from binlog (missing file copy)
scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently found the error in a single tool call and provided a clear, well-structured summary. It identified the error code, project, target framework, and context. The only minor weakness is that the full file path wasn't shown (though this may be due to truncation in the tool output). The agent also added useful context about why the error might have occurred.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified the MSB3030 error (could not copy file)
Included the full file path that was not found
Mentioned what the copy target was trying to do (copy a project output file)
Noted the target framework (net8.0-windows) involved in the failure
